text: Here are some things you can do
to feel better,
and manage the effects of heart failure.
Firstly, take your medicine as prescribed
by your doctor.
Manage your fluids.
Keep track of your intake,
and avoid things like salt,
which can hold fluid in your body.
Stay below your daily fluid limit
if your doctor gave you one.
Reduce your intake of alcohol
and do not smoke to protect your heart.
Remember to talk to your health care team
if you need help to drink less,
or to quit cigarettes.
Sitting less, and regular physical activity
are important for your heart, your mind,
and your whole body.
A heart healthy diet
with lots of fresh foods,
rich in fruit, vegetables, and whole grains,
are very important in looking after your heart.
Stay up to date with vaccinations
and keep regular contact with your doctor
and health care team.
Don't hesitate to talk to them
if you feel unwell,
or have concerns about heart failure.
And to learn more about managing heart failure,
watch the other videos in this series.
